full_prompt_en: A square documentary color photograph centers on a weathered black-and-white face poster pasted onto a coarse beige stucco wall. The paper shows a close frontal face cropped tightly from the forehead to the chin. One eye looks out from a dark socket; the other lies under torn, folded paper, and the nose and mouth emerge from heavy gray-black printed shadows. The poster is rectangular in outline but no longer clean. Its corners curl, the upper edge is creased, and a large section near the lower right has lifted into a pale flap that partly covers the printed face. Smaller rips and cracks cross the image, exposing the uneven plaster below. A second thin layer of paper seems trapped beneath the main sheet around its bottom edge. The wall occupies the rest of the composition with rough sandy texture, darker scratches, and patches of old adhesive or chipped coating. There is no visible street sign or readable text, and the identity of the printed person is uncertain. Flat daylight comes from above and slightly left, making the raised paper edges throw small shadows and emphasizing the difference between matte ink, thin worn paper, and gritty wall. Color remains restrained: warm stone beige surrounds cool gray and dense black printing. The camera faces the wall almost squarely at close range, giving the surface an archival, found-image quality. The visual tension comes from a human gaze that survives physical damage and partial concealment. It feels like an accidental urban collage made over time by weather rather than a freshly designed graphic.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形纪实彩色摄影以贴在粗糙米色灰泥墙上的一张风化黑白人脸海报为中心。纸上是从前额到下巴紧密裁切的正面面孔。一只眼从深色眼窝中向外看；另一只眼被撕裂折起的纸遮住，鼻子与嘴从浓重灰黑印刷阴影中浮出。海报大致仍是矩形，但已不再整洁。纸角卷起，上边缘布满折痕，右下附近有一大片纸翻成浅色翘片，遮住部分印刷面孔。细小裂口和裂纹横穿图像，露出底下不平整的灰泥。下缘似乎还有一层薄纸压在主海报下面。墙占据其余构图，有粗糙沙砾肌理、较深划痕，以及旧胶痕或剥落涂层。看不到街牌或可读文字，也无法确定印刷人物的身份。平实日光从上方略偏左照来，让翘起纸边投下小影，强调哑光油墨、磨薄纸张与砂质墙面的差别。色彩克制：暖石米色包围冷灰与浓黑印刷。相机近距离几乎正对墙面，使表面具有档案式、偶然发现的影像气质。视觉张力来自一道人类目光在实物破损与部分遮蔽后依然存在。它像一幅随天气与岁月形成的偶然城市拼贴，而非刚设计出的图形。
style_prompt_en: Urban documentary photography treats a weathered surface as a found collage. Rough neutral plaster fills the frame around a limited black-and-white printed fragment, setting warm sandy color against cool gray ink. Torn edges, curled corners, lifted paper, adhesive traces, and fine cracks create layered physical depth on an otherwise nearly flat wall. Soft daylight gives raised material small realistic shadows rather than theatrical modeling. Close, square-on framing emphasizes surface texture and the uneasy relationship between a recognizable printed fragment and its decay. Contrast is strongest within the old graphic; the surrounding wall remains low-key and granular. The mood is quiet, imperfect, and timeworn, with visual interest arising from material erosion, partial concealment, and the chance placement of an image in ordinary space.
style_prompt_zh: 城市纪实摄影把风化表面当作偶然形成的拼贴。粗糙中性色灰泥围绕有限的黑白印刷碎片，暖砂色与冷灰油墨相对。撕裂边缘、卷起纸角、翘起的纸、胶痕和细裂缝在原本近乎平面的墙上形成层叠实物纵深。柔和日光给凸起材料留下细小真实的影子，而非戏剧化塑形。贴近且正对的取景强调表面肌理，以及可辨印刷碎片与其衰败之间的不安关系。最强反差在旧图像内部，周围墙面保持低调颗粒感。氛围安静、不完美且经年磨损，视觉趣味来自材料侵蚀、局部遮蔽，以及图像在平凡空间中的偶然位置。
theme_en: A torn black-and-white face poster clings to a rough city wall
theme_zh: 一张黑白人脸旧海报贴在粗糙的城市墙面上
name: Wheatpaste
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
